Replay

Godot bridge goal progress

4 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
B1 foundation — 2026-09-20B2 typed views and projections — 2026-09-20B3 definition baking — 2026-09-20B4 input and signals — 2026-09-20B5 visual/audio routes — 2026-09-20B6 body contracts — 2026-09-20B7 measurement and delivery — 2026-09-20

Completed scope: B1–B7 plan. This is separate from the completed framework-first implementation. The typed authoring layers and final measured delivery gate are now complete.

B1 foundation — 2026-09-20#

Implemented bounded view.Key_Index, lifetime-preserving handle keys, indexed Nodes2 reconciliation/lookup, opt-in property caching and explicit invalidation. Default callers continue reapplying root properties. Duplicate/zero IDs are preflighted before scene changes, and full-capacity replacement remains supported.

Twenty-six view tests/WASM checking, a real Godot lifecycle/property/resource test, and existing Hello/Loot presentation tests in an isolated copy pass. A dense presentation-call benchmark compares the preserved old owner, indexing alone and caching with identical moving-position input. At 1,024 views the median call is 630.4 / 111.6 / 46.1 microseconds. Caching avoids about 75% of property calls in that workload. These are not rendered-frame/GPU or whole-game timings. Extra bounded index/cache memory is a tradeoff; sparse and very small pools need separate measurement before universal performance claims.

See API/lifetime contract and focused evidence.

B2 typed views and projections — 2026-09-20#

Implemented detached replay.project, bounded typed entity projections, explicit predicted/observed/authoritative selection, interpolation and teleport cuts, and View_Pool2(Entity, Value, Rig). Child bindings attach once per lifetime, paint skips unchanged values, and epoch/reset changes recreate rigs. Hello now uses the bridge; gameplay code and World hashes remain unchanged.

32 core tests and 29 view tests pass, with WASM compilation. Actual Godot checks cover lifecycle, cached child properties, invalidation and failure cleanup. Existing Hello/Loot, rewind, inspector/branching, recording verification, rendered inspector and network inspection checks pass. See evidence. No projection speedup is claimed yet; Hello's expanded view batch is larger than its tiny World, and by-value projection may still copy State.

B3 definition baking — 2026-09-20#

Implemented typed immutable definition stores, semantic/schema/content identity, owned field diagnostics, explicit retained-version pins and transactional baking. The Godot scope owns temporary scenes and supports validated nested marker transforms. Cavecrawl uses one atomic bake for its authored two-floor set, retaining presentation scenes only after success. Definitions remain embedded in World, so its checkpoint format is unchanged.

Pure store/WASM and real Godot extraction checks pass, including failure cleanup. Existing Cavecrawl authored-content, mutation isolation, save/reload and six invalid input cases pass; all scripts also compile for WASM. See evidence.

B4 input and signals — 2026-09-20#

Implemented engine-free buffered Control_Capture, typed InputMap bindings and a stable-address Signal_Action owner over existing Action_Intent. Gates suppress held inputs across pause/focus/menu boundaries; signal payloads are copied on click, with explicit one-slot overflow and cancel/keep policy. Recovery still rebinds accepted tickets while UI submission is paused.

33 core tests/Loot/WASM and actual Godot input/signal/retry/epoch/recovery/disconnect checks pass. Complete native fixture scripts also compile for WASM. See evidence and API contracts.

B5 visual/audio routes — 2026-09-20#

Implemented declarative Cue_Route, Effect_Route2 and Audio_Route over existing journal IDs, bounded cue/voice pools and typed views. Routes follow journal policy or delay until confirmation. Updates/confirmation preserve scene and playback lifetimes; canceled/expired/dropped IDs remain consumed, and slot reuse gets new view generations.

30 view tests/WASM, a shared native/executed WASM lifecycle corpus, and actual Godot scene/audio identity, cancellation and cleanup checks pass. Complete engine fixture scripts compile for WASM. See evidence and route contracts.

B6 body contracts — 2026-09-20#

Implemented distinct Simulation_Body2/3 pose bindings and Session adapters selecting only authority state for cooperative Body2/3. The sample facade rechecks fencing, phase, pause and epoch; missing state suspends the producer. Existing transfer, reseed, correction and admission semantics remain in the owned-body protocol.

11 owned-protocol tests/WASM and actual Godot checks in both dimensions pass for authored offsets, freeze, invalid input, preparing/accepted transfer, cuts, fencing, recovered epochs and pause. Complete fixture scripts compile for WASM. See evidence and body contracts.

B7 measurement and delivery — 2026-09-20#

Completed sparse/dense comparisons including the typed owner, and actual Hello/ Scrapyard copy, public/authority encode/hash, advance and suffix-replay profiles. The sparse comparison exposed avoidable capacity work. Occupied-bucket clearing and a fully retained membership path remove it without changing lifecycle or preflight behavior; dense cases improved too. Typed 1/1024 calls measured 4.208 → 0.050 µs; typed 1024/1024 measured 67.458 → 61.892 µs in paired runs.

The selective read benchmark allows compiler copy elimination; detached projection has a small validation cost and is not claimed as a universal copy speedup. Materialized Scrapyard reads measured 0.926 µs and 16-tick replay 149.332 µs in the final profile. COW/chunked history is deferred; broader encoding caches need exact recipient/connection/content dependencies before safe implementation.

Final validation passes 76 pure tests, native/WASM recipes, executed WASM route checks and the actual Godot bridge fixture. Rebuilt Hello/Loot and inspector/ recording/network checks pass. All 65 baseline Kit hashes match, original game directories and sibling Scrapyard remain clean. No parity expansion was needed.

The goal is complete. See performance and tradeoffs, delivery evidence and public contracts linked from the Godot integration entry point.
